text:
Maya S.: quick handoff — calibration dataset and weights locations for the AWQ candidate (asking for quick QA + ops checks)

Jon Park: thanks — can you paste the s3 path and tokenizer version? also any perf/latency expectations?

Maya S.: s3://redwood-models/weights/mpt-7b-awq/v2/sha-3f2b
Tokenizer: tiktoken v0.3.5 fork with whitespace-fix (tokenizer.json included in same bucket under /tokenizer/)
Expected tail latency ~55ms p50 on ded-500 pool, batch=4.

Tara Liu: noted. Are we running AWQ or GPTQ for this rollout? FP8 considered?

Maya S.: primary plan = AWQ-8 -> fallback GPTQ-4 for accuracy checks. FP8 is experimental; we tried fp8 on small eval but saw higher hallucination on long-context prompts.

Alan G.: can you attach the calib config and sample of the calibration set? I want to run a quick local pass.

Maya S.: pasted config below (also uploaded to the bucket at /calib/configs/awq-v2.yaml)

```yaml
calib_dataset: s3://redwood-models/weights/mpt-7b-awq/v2/calib/2026-03-07
num_samples: 1024
batch_size: 32
quant: AWQ
bit_width: 8
holdout_ratio: 0.05
metrics: [perplexity, rouge-l, exact_match]
acceptance_thresholds:
  perplexity: 1.15
  rouge-l: -0.02  # relative delta allowed
```

Maya S.: sample prompt examples in /calib/sample_prompts.jsonl, includes multi-turn chat and long context docs.

calib-bot: auto-check: weights checksum OK (sha256: a1b2...f8). tokenizer.json present. Config schema validated. No blocking schema errors.

Jon Park: thanks for bot check. Alan — can you run quant-ops checklist? I can do model-serving smoke later today.

Alan G.: running now. Quick checklist I'm doing:
- Validate tokenization parity vs prod tokenizer
- Ensure kv-cache shape matches compiled kernels
- Confirm no mismapped EOS tokens
- Run small eval (100 samples) for AWQ and GPTQ

Alan G.: tokenization diff: 3 tokens different on 1024 sample compare (mostly unicode whitespace) — will patch tokenizer fork to normalize U+00A0 -> space.

Maya S.: ok go ahead, patched tokenizer has been uploaded to same path as tokenizer_v2.json. Please re-run parity check.

Alan G.: re-run -> parity OK after normalizer. small eval results:
AWQ-8: ppl 1.12 (baseline fp32 1.00), rouge-l delta -0.018
GPTQ-4: ppl 1.09, rouge-l delta -0.015
FP8-probe: ppl 1.25, rouge-l delta -0.05 (worse)

Tara Liu: those numbers look within our acceptance for AWQ (perplexity <1.15 and rouge-l delta > -0.02). AWQ slightly worse than GPTQ but better perf. Need product signoff for quality tradeoff?

Maya S.: product signoff requested — @Jon Park could you confirm we can accept AWQ on hosted with auto-fallback to GPTQ when quality regression observed? Also note Dedicated customers may want GPTQ pinned.

Jon Park: from infra side auto-fallback is doable by route policy; we need a canary rollout first. ops: ensure we have logs to detect rouge/regression per prompt set.

Maya S.: added eval hooks and alert rule: rolling mean rouge-l over evaluation set must not drop below -0.02 for 30m window, otherwise traffic shifts to GPTQ variant. Rule already in console under model/mpt-7b-awq/v2/alerts.

calib-bot: canary rollout scheduled at 2026-03-15T22:00Z on ded-500 pool, 10% traffic for 2h, auto-promote if no alerts.

Alan G.: running config validation for serving runtime; found one memory config mismatch in serving.json (kv_cache_max_tokens: 8192 -> should be 12288 for 7b long-context). Fixed and pushed: serving.json (commit sha b7c9).

Maya S.: thanks. CI/QA — any blocking from deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: deploy check: CI green, infra quotas available, canary window free. No blockers.

Jon Park: I'll do the product QA ping — Tara can you post a short note in #product-qa summarizing the perf vs accuracy tradeoffs and ask for signoff? I'll add canary details.

Tara Liu: will do. Quick draft: "AWQ-8 for mpt-7b: +~20% p50 latency improvement vs GPTQ-4, small quality delta within thresholds (rouge-l delta -0.018). Auto-fallback to GPTQ scheduled. Requesting signoff to start canary 2026-03-15 22:00Z."

Maya S.: perfect. Also FYI — calibration dataset includes specialized docs (legal/terms) that increased hallucination for FP8. We explicitly excluded FP8 for now.

Jon Park: sounds good. Who's owning post-canary rollback/playbook? Alan?

Alan G.: I'll own the post-canary playbook. Draft in /runbooks/mpt-7b-awq-canary.md — will add steps for rollback, metric checks, and emergency scale.

Maya S.: thanks all. If no objections I'll kick off canary onboarding ticket and tag infra + product.

Jon Park: no objections from me. Thx team. :thumbsup:

Tara Liu: +1

Alan G.: +1

Maya S.: filing ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4427 (canary + auto-fallback)

calib-bot: ticket INF-4427 linked to model version mpt-7b-awq/v2.
